Hi Anika / Ben —

Thanks again for the call today — appreciate the clear goals and the marketplace rhythms you outlined. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

- Goal alignment: integrate StratusWorks listing with Redwood Dedicated marketplace, aim for phased launch (private listing pilot -> public listing).
- Technical owners: Luca (cc'd) will be the StratusWorks integration lead; Camila will be our Redwood field engineer for the technical deep dive.
- Immediate asks from us: high-level SSO requirements, expected manifest format, and any firewall/IP allowlists.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) Technical deep dive (60m) — demo of the marketplace onboarding flow and integration checklist. Suggested window: this week Wed/Thu between 10–12 PT.
2) Shared runbook: Hannah to upload an initial runbook draft (permissions & listing steps).
3) Legal/procurement: Ben to loop in procurement if the SOW needs modifications.

Attachments: Stratus_SOW_v0.3.pdf (draft), marketplace-integration-checklist.xlsx (high-level).

If the times above don't work, share two slots that do and we'll coordinate.

Thanks —
Hannah
